hardwareHubs.note: MakeIt Labs is described as New Hampshire's first and largest makerspace with CNC and laser equipment.
Port City Makerspace has a CNC room, machine shop and electronics lab.

makerspaces.name: MakeIt Labs
makerspaces.note: Lists a manual and CNC machine shop, CNC router table, laser cutting and 3D printing.

makerspaces.name: Port City Makerspace
makerspaces.note: Lists a CNC room with routers, a machine shop, metal shop and electronics lab with 3D printing.

makerspaces.name: Manchester Makerspace
makerspaces.note: Lists welding and plasma cutting, 3D printers, laser etchers and a computer lab.

makerspaces.name: Makerspace at the ECenter
makerspaces.note: Lists a DATRON CNC mill, 40-watt laser, 3D printers and an electronics station, free to the UNH community.

events.name: NH Maker Fest
events.note: Run by the Children's Museum of New Hampshire; the listed 15th edition is on June 5, 2027.

programs.name: UNH Entrepreneurship Center (ECenter)
programs.note: Runs a student makerspace with CNC milling, laser cutting and 3D printing.

specialties.name: Advanced manufacturing cluster
specialties.note: The state's economic affairs office describes a cluster including aerospace and defense, fabricated metal, electronics and machinery that makes medical devices, semiconductors and precision optics.

specialties.name: Precision bearings
specialties.note: New Hampshire Ball Bearings in Peterborough makes precision bearings for aerospace, defense and medical device markets.

support.name: New Hampshire Manufacturing Extension Partnership (NHMEP)
support.note: NIST MEP center offering lean training, quality systems and technology help to small and medium-sized manufacturers.
